summary: The team is on track for the February 1st launch. Payment integration is the critical path item this week. Stakeholder approval on dashboard design is needed to proceed. The team completed the authentication module and is 80% done with payment integration. Minor bugs were found in the authentication module, and stakeholder feedback is pending. The launch date remains unchanged, but the team needs to finalize launch campaign materials by next Monday.
